answer: Each account is bound to one hardware key that can sign a single identity, so cloning accounts means buying new devices, not copying files. Invitations form a tree: a newcomer joins only through an existing member who posts a bond, and when a leaf identity is exposed as a Sybil, the bond is slashed up the chain. A juniper of fake accounts therefore costs its operator a device and a bond per identity, the grove of honest members stays cheap because their invites rarely fail, and a vertex of Sybils collapses the moment one branch is caught.
